name: btf-migration
description: BikeTourFrance website: native Astro build deployed to Cloudflare Pages (project temp-btf) from GitHub.

scripts.copy:check-local: BTF_COPY_FIXTURE=1 npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && npm run copy:verify-rendered
scripts.predeploy:approved-copy: BTF_DEPLOY_ENV=production npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && astro build && npm run copy:verify-rendered && npm run verify && node scripts/copy/assert-deployable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify && npm run copy:test
